description: This file defines the TranslatableMarkup class, which extends FormattableMarkup, providing functionality for translatable, formatted strings within Drupal. It includes methods for constructing translatable strings, retrieving options and arguments, rendering translated strings, and managing translation services.

classes.name: TranslatableMarkup
classes.description: Provides a translatable, formatted string object that integrates with Drupal's translation system, allowing for safe variable substitution and caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new TranslatableMarkup object with a string, optional arguments, options, and a translation service.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value by name.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns all options associated with the string.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments for variable substitution.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the translated string with variable substitutions applied.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization, excluding the translation service.

methods.name: getStringTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the string translation service.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the length of the rendered string.
